propositions: The DC transport lacks 12 methods the core reconciler requires (delete_issue, delete_issue_link, get_comments, get_issue_by_rest, get_issue_links, get_parent_map, remove_label, set_entity_property, set_issue_property, set_parent, set_reporter, validate_assignee_exists), causing crashes at some call sites and silent functional degradation at others.

The TicketTransport protocol is not @runtime_checkable and does not declare the 21 distinct members the core actually calls, so isinstance conformance checks raise TypeError and cannot guard at construction time.

DC's reporter sync re-emits on every pass because inbound_fields._identity_of reads only accountId (null on DC), never the username field that DC provides, causing infinite churn and violating idempotence even after a successful set_reporter call.

Seven of the 12 absent methods have call sites that swallow all exceptions at every invocation, resulting in silent data loss (comments, links, parents, issue properties, assignee validation) without any observable error or log.
